targets.quote: minimising the Union’s contribution to deforestation and forest degradation worldwide, and thereby contributing to a reduction in global deforestation;
targets.label: objective
indicators: Union contribution to deforestation and forest degradation

targets.quote: reducing the Union’s contribution to greenhouse gas emissions and global biodiversity loss.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: that the relevant products contain, have been fed with or have been made using, relevant commodities that were produced on land that has not been subject to deforestation after 31 December, 2020; and
targets.label: other

targets.quote: in the case of relevant products that contain or have been made using wood, that the wood has been harvested from the forest without inducing forest degradation after 31 December, 2020;
targets.label: other

targets.quote: Relevant commodities and relevant products shall not be placed or made available on the market or exported, unless all the following conditions are fulfilled:
targets.label: other

targets.quote: they have been produced in accordance with the relevant legislation of the country of production; and
targets.label: other

targets.quote: they are covered by a due diligence statement.
targets.label: other

targets.quote: Operators shall exercise due diligence in accordance with Article 8 prior to placing relevant products on the market or exporting them in order to prove that the relevant products comply with Article 3.
targets.label: other
